name: MLPS Review
tagline: Manage MLPS projects, knowledge bases, and document review records.
description: MLPS Review helps teams manage companies, MLPS projects, company knowledge bases, and document review records. The app reads ordinary PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and XLS files with Anna native doc_read/sheet_read when available, keeps the bundled Executa for archives and OCR fallback, retrieves relevant company knowledge, and asks the host LLM for compliance gaps, evidence, and remediation suggestions.
